title: Parish Registration
successBody: The parish office will follow up with you. Watch for a copy of this form in your email.

steps.title: Getting started
steps.help: This takes about ten minutes. We save your progress as you go, so you can close this and come back.

fields.label: What would you like to do?

options.label: Register with the parish
options.help: You are new to us, or you have never filled this out.

options.label: Update information we already have
options.help: You are already registered and something changed.

fields.label: Envelope number
fields.help: Optional. This helps us find your existing household record.

fields.label: Previous ZIP code
fields.help: Optional. Use the ZIP code already on your parish record if it changed.

fields.html: This information is used for the purposes of the Church Office only and will not be given out without consent.

steps.title: Head of household
steps.help: Start with the adult the parish office should contact first.

steps.title: Sacramental record
steps.help: Answer for yourself. If you are not sure of a date, say so and leave it blank. We can look it up together later.

fields.label: Email address
fields.help: Most parish communication goes out by email.

checks.message: Please give us at least one way to reach you: an email address or a phone number.

fields.label: Is there a spouse or second adult in the household?

steps.title: Their sacramental record
steps.help: Same questions, for the second adult in the household.

fields.label: Are there children in the household?
Children
fields.help: Add one for each child. There is no limit.

_comment: The paper registration form carries no photo release, so this wording is
not reproduced from an original. It follows the publication list used on
the paper faith formation form. Changes are the pastor's call.
Asked as an explicit choice rather than an opt-out box so the answer is
recorded either way. A blank checkbox would leave no record of consent.
steps.title: Photographs
steps.help: Parish life gets photographed. Tell us how you would like your household handled.

fields.html: Photographs taken at Mass, sacraments, and parish events are sometimes used in the bulletin, in faith formation materials, and on the parish website. Your answer applies to everyone listed on this form and you can change it at any time by calling the parish office.

fields.label: May we use photographs of your household in parish publications?

options.label: Yes, our household's photographs may be used.
No, please do not use our household's photographs.

steps.title: Check your answers
steps.help: Everything you entered is below. Use Back to change anything.

fields.html: This information is used for the purposes of the Church Office only and will not be given out without consent.
